notes.title: Gravity Update
notes.content:
Hey Drivers,

Following two years of updates from numerous players, besides talking with top game performers, there is the conclusion to increase the gravity for 20%, and it will results in:

- Less jumps over smaller hills, which will enable you to race more on the ground and get better times
- much stable controls
- less side jumps
- more of controls during jumps
- less in-air-time, which means more controls over rig, during heavy stunts over hills
- less moon-land-physics
- no-fly physics
- less 2-wheely physics

Also:
- car will be more downed to the ground 
- suspensions becomes stiffer 
- overall you feel more stable during off-road maneuvers

Let compare what's better in terms of performances, joy, race times, and let me know if you like this update, also if you think that gravity can be even higher, or like little lower.

Cheers up!

notes.title: Introduction to the AD 2.0: Big Pack of New Features and Optimizations
notes.content:
Note that since of substantial shrinking of file size on HD (from 65GB on launch to 26GB and finally now to just 15GB), it will take longer to download this patch to those who have the game already installed. The patch will be rolled in the period from 8-9 March 2021.


Hello Racers from around the globe,

Arizona Derby getting to the next level, bringing a new patch with extreme updates, to make it the world's best racing game in terms of gameplay, graphics, smoothest, and most immersive experiences. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/1122c4c659fc934a9e3aacc6c9632df035b69fd1.jpg
Winter is almost over, but Arizona Derby Season is just about to starts.

We don't have any marketing, you're here only due to the visibility that Steam gave us (and thanks for it), so one way or another more racing fans will be finding the game and enjoy its huge world's. 


Switching to the  latest Unreal Engine version brought more performance improvements, softest and even more high-end graphics, leaving AAA racing competition in the dust and dirt

And now, without further ado, we're opening a hood:


0. ZERO POINT GAME-OPTIMIZATION

Yes, it's under point ZERO since it will remove the main (now called 'micro stuttering since optimization was improved over time, but still weren't perfect) which was there for years...with very helpful advice from player Hexaae, I do additional optimizations and culling volumes, with all the latest optimizations on the grass particles spawned from tires, firework side, also particles pooling logics, also improved occlusion culling techniques, those visibility cullings make stable 60fps over time.

0a. GAME PACKAGE WAS REDUCED TO JUST 15 GB!

The game package was reduced after its release in July 2019 from initially 65GB to 26GB. The game has  32 open-world tracks, over 85 cars, 35 ADrivers, and a very large amount of customizations, over 100 soundtracks, etc.

The game size on the disc is now reduced just to the unbelievable 15GB for this kind of content, it's really nothing for the amount of the content it offers compared to the other AAA racers, similar in content, and their sizes are about 60GB.


1. Balancing Dirt's off the Cars

This is the core of an off-road game and no matter, we loves our advanced shader work with making supercars extremely dirt, it wasn't always a pleasure to watch it, especially like 80% of the game:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/18b68b4ab8061609cca269247a617a0caa7b47dc.jpg

or:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/d88a5a75292450bbd026f56b285b8dd44a3b271f.jpg

or like this, which may looks glitchy in some occasions:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/128c57775b8571989a6c1e6cee8fd7cd18e3d36a.png

Such dirt will be much more balanced in terms of cleaner cars:
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/311dabf79d7d41a171dd097693b0b632e55344b9.jpg

So finally, we get to move unnecessary dirt from the game (you can also wash the car by going through the waters) and to get much more realistic things.
This thing was done long ago, I was so proud of super-realistic shaders and spent weeks into them, that lately I never thought about making cars less dirt and finally, that's happening, so you'll see all the normal dirt, but not some heavy stuff over the car like before. Glass dynamic dirting has also its own way of dirt algorithm and will becoming slowly dirtier, like car materials:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/eef2ead50a002f7c878497ad84cf574bc4c063c7.png
there's dynamic weather systems together with all glass material dynamism:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/71d3a84d1e6289ed683de1ac27f98b9c60024f21.jpg
and interior will be less dirt than this:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/c460eafd4a680ea8f90a0fabdec7e87862566c76.png
or even this:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/a8c81a50e06d86feca9178af3bde36aabea3ecbb.png

Dirt levels of car chassis will be going from:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/700c0c9aea91871655e1895ae0c4341f92535802.png

To more tuned values like:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/2e31a1969bd43d6bc272f74aec9926251685a102.jpg


2. Top ADriver's named after best AD Players ever

First of all also will love to give a special hola, to the best racers in-game, and the main characters are now made by guys that topped leaderboards over the previous one and a half years, showing exceptional skills (AD off-road racing require a special skill set which they mastered).

The first top player to get his character in-game is XXZ3ROXX, this dude literally hits out lists with the fastest possible times, we never thought it's possible, and the most expensive ADriver character is named after him, you can unlock him with AD$ earned in-game competitions:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/e516beebb0a4b865313dd9a6c6713c8c49829baf.jpg

Next, who follow him and even in some tracks topped over his results is LUNATEK, he's also mastered and achieved insane times at the lists:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/361d70de523033bb8c7afe8c263cdd8e73b77e9f.jpg

 Another one, who also track them in the feet, is the NITEVISION, rated very highly, gets top times on many tracks:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/a84cb3ec6ca75a52b406bbf1338bc4852e62f068.jpg

Next is the MARTENS78, he's playing for a long period of time, on low-end pc and after upgrading rig, he's was amazed what's the graphics on game, he's doing really great as well, he was a leader at many tracks before XXZ3 and NITE top the lists down, congrats, buddy:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/2a8110ad09808e6d5c22d75c0c71c93a713d6970.jpg

Also, we have FLASHBAC85, who's winning the top lists over months and years like Martens, he helped with many feedback, along with many other players (who's also on lists and thank you guy, more of ADrivers will take the name after you).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/4b560184419939695b6bf2610a4f95ab71209207.jpg(please note that Bio in boxes to the ADrivers default from the original version of the game, I changed just theirs's names, if some of you want to add something custom there, please contact me).


We're so proud of you guys, congratulations on it and congratulating the many others mentioned in the previous update and many of tens of thousands who put their names on the top lists, not mentioned, you're doing a great job, congrats guys and girls.

3. Customization of the Controls 


There are some changes in information and visuals of the customization controls, also gamepad customizations (since it was experimental) was revoked, so the player can customize keyboard controls.

Latter on this to be extended with full customizations of everything, that's not only 
Car Racing, but also ADrone controls, ADriver controls, other controls (music, pause, soundtrack...), Photo Mode controls. There's too many stuff in-game, so take care what you override, bellow was default customizations maps:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/f03fa279c3e25cfa2005da8254b1266b3d0cd1da.jpg
so you can check on the map, and not override some other important buttons. I will extend this lately, when the game gets more famous, with further customizations, for now, it's okay to have these basic car controls customized.


4.  Missing & Fixing Boss Avatar in SMS overlay at HUD

For some reason, in corner of the screen, it was missing Boss pictures and has been put there, so you can check the latest and very useful information during racings (or turn this out if you don't need it, in Settings).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/0324f923099d3dd81715e4bd73ee8a320c4dc0c5.jpg
Theis notifications were visible, in some cases, during the game pause, and now that's prevented.
Similarly, they'll not appear during Photo Mode.
There's over hundreds of useful tips, and you'll be informed from level

5.  Some scenes has new lighting built

And this light's now looks nice, like Menu's scenes and lightmaps are optimized so it's achieved even faster loading times and performances.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/b7658f5da3ee9a42abf1b294453f9a817a8386aa.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/a0c8e8a4311cf6e31d68f22266f50df1dc4e7c02.jpg

So all looks even step ahead realistic.

6.  Loading screen gets more informations

Loading from menu scene to race will give you more useful information, loading time is blazing fast (comparing to the other AAA racers, were sometimes taking minutes) but anyways it's for your smoother experience, i.e. if you playing 1000s of races:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/701fb64f926852d27ca1c713b4782deedbb3f3af.jpg


7.  Fixings some parts, lightings, and other stuff in intro scenes

Like initial supercar has some weird transparent spoiler, and few other little glitches, now fixed, so you can enjoy the intro scene:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/27148b6189b14784e0bf29cf423c40856e625849.jpg

Also lighting rebuild and more optimized, so it should run more smoothly. It's complex comparing to 99% of other games, it has plenty of high-end content, depicting real off-road garage, so that's why it is optimized over the period to work on your rigs as smooth as possible.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/aa8b0cf61cc202eca0c94a32d22eebc06ebd0dac.jpg
Picture above is AD off-road testing unit

8.  Terrain Glitches and Little Polishing Along the Way

AD has 32 big open world's tracks and it's very complex to set it out everything, but over time, I smooth it out and now doing things like:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/50f3fb789f20a1d1283da4cc9978f0cb07c33ae5.jpg
for maximum perfections (when launched, as of many tracks changes, tracks were widened to be practical without boundaries, so that's left many objects in the air. And that's fixed like a year ago with help of many players all over maps, and now I tried to go over all levels and fix these final parts to be perfect, as it's possible:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/853448fe49e3dca57767130e167783ce40528fa0.jpg
and final part of the level:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/bfbf802112f7678539d1c9668da11dcbb6c459d6.jpg
(Right-click to open the picture in full quality in the new browser tab).

So, such things (due to many changes over years making this wide off-road terrains, from initial very limited and narrow roads):
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/62b055107246d0a8612eae79101359279f8cf929.jpg
Is less likely to be discovered all over 32 levels.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/f664910044a04e3c8d6ea8c2baccb95b6a674d0a.jpg

9.  More Colorful Garage

Starting from this build I introduce more colors into the garage, so it will look vivid and interesting for spending time pimping and tuning rigs into the garage and gets some cool workout done, to pack for racings.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/1bc51ba0ccf4221896474b5fca8658c2a34107de.jpg

Also, the main stage, there will be AD$ Treasury held and populated with earned golden packs, was before this build more flatten, so now looks like this:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/76a5689899d44b77084fe4afd21e5d2071b4eec9.jpg
11.  Setting out "AD-GAS" feature

This is still an experimental feature, but it may provide in future needs for you to have enough gas in order to play, so you should, like in real life, after a lot of races, put some gas into engines in order to race. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/7dd66f5015bf73dba0b9316c591df366913d65cf.jpg
"AD-GAS" feature is just to replicate realism since gas will be affordable in the game.
 
12.  Moving years from the AD-flags

Before, there were outdated years in flags (those flags were made in 2016, so they updated till 2020), in-racings but also in the menu, so now years been removed.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/36e61d9af7cf5327b20eff74693ec3ff8ae808d0.jpg


13.  ADJ's Music Players Improving

ADJ's is an Arizona Derby music disc jokey radio that mixes over 100's of the greatest hits while you racing, with a lot of licensed music and custom-created soundtracks. There's some changes to the latest edition:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/9be05e335c4d95b0144e7ef27a3bb4c0e2d14a24.jpg

If you want, you can turn it on for your car (it will be better performance than before when other AI racers also have it).

Now it's default turned off and just car days light (very optimized) glow. Point lights, which were very GPU intense, are turned off.

Also, before during the day, that creates sometimes too many bright scenes that looked like glitches, so that's turned all down (when some car gets close to the other cars, too many extensive lights during day time, changes its visual appearing). So now that's fixed.

Arizona Derby has implemented one of the most advanced realistic reflection shaders into the game industry, enabling great quality of the cars and extreme realism. However, with some materials, we're not satisfied and their reflections were improved.

17.  Package size has been optimized

notes.title: Boss and Gangs Overview in 'Arizona Derby'
notes.content:
Hello Off-road champs,

'Arizona Derby' consists of 5 different championships and one bonus Championship. 

[olist]
 Forest Ride
 Redwood Rush
 Canada Trophy
 Tropical Storm
 Siberia Run
 Dubai Drive (bonus Competition) 
[/olist]

Each of the main Championships having 6 different tracks to compete on. You need to adapt your skills to each of the different tracks and special types of Championships, in a way to become the #1 rider.

Each of the gang members having its own driving style and you'll compete with the same crew members at a particular Competition, so you can, racing them many times, find the most appropriate ways to overtake them, which will also depend on different kinds of off-road tracks.

Each of the crew members is specific and will play his part in the overall AD Competition, so you need to understand and win them all.
Also, each of the Bosses will play differently and you can upgrade your rig and practicing more, compete with them all.

Also, you have different levels of AI's skills, so you can set from easy to overwhelm insane skills, which you need to acquire as well in order to win. 

And you having over 85 different cars, to buy, upgrade, customize to show to the world your best off-road skillset (one of the future updates will cover racing rigs).

On top of that, you have over 35 different characters with all 100s of different emotes to choose to play, as your ADriver - Driver avatar. There's plenty of different ADriver's styles to unlock.

And finally, you can choose from different ADrones, each having adopted and unique qualities, with whom you can fastly escape from some routes and move car whenever appropriate is for more score and chance to win better results.
Finally, when you beat the in-game boss, you need to put your scores also at 32 different leaderboards (for every race one).

notes.title: Update 0.96.2a: Important Physics Fixes, Ai Aggressivity & Visual Polishings
notes.content:
Hello riders,


This is a fast update that addresses visual effects from exhausts of the cars.


1) No speed-offs or stucks while jumping/riding over harsh terrains
This is very important, for some long-expected physics fixes that make overall gameplay more smoother, stable and nice to play without annoying stocks which few negative commentators addressed over the previous period (thank you guys, god's bless you), so hopefully, they'll be happier after this update (at least I enjoying gameplay maximally after this update).

You can't fly in big jumps and speed-off on landing, that makes before stocks in smooth gameplay and make people felt annoyed (or you need to be master of the skills like me and few other top racers so to evade those possibilities, lol),  you can see how smooth is gameplay now, no stocks, game-flow is still dramatic, extremely off-road realistic, but you can ride your way without that annoying thing, which makes overall gameplay more addictive
[previewyoutube=jCZj196BU1E;full][/previewyoutube]
Again, this is ain't final physics, the game is a very complex 5-year old form of most-realistic physics in off-road racings; it was very hard to make AI's rushing 400kmh perfectly over realistic (not flatten offroad like other racing games) along with tuning physics, which has endless components and functions, in order to calculate all perfect and ultra-realistic and to still be fun for you. So you can expect in the future along with continuous progress with the physics's algorithms of 'Arizona Derby' that more and more fixes come, making overall racing very well-tuned, balanced, polished, smooth and extremely appealing for the ride.

notes.title: v0.94.1a.7: 31 Leaderboards, New Track & Improvement by Players Feedback's
notes.content:
Hi Ridaz,
First of all, thanks for all your feedback, which helps me to see issues, the scope of the work is huge and there is tons of stuff to be fine-tuned to such game. So I tried to sort them one after another, in order to make something really fun to play. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/ddd656eb8cdc86b5983362f05ca99fd409cc1c55.png

Currently, 'Arizona Derby' gets to the 0.94 version, which means more functionality and smooth gameplay. And it's about the right time to make all more challenging, so overall skills of the AI's were set to a higher level, and playing on a higher level will bring you more XP/AD$. You need to compete in order to get to the top. Once you played and open all the tracks, defeating boss levels (32 different track altogether),  you can increase skills and play on harder settings, finally, you can set on the 'Total Madness' skills which are almost unbeatable (yours is to prove that is possible, getting best cars and packing your rig to the max).


1) LEADERBOARDS OF BEST TIMES AT 32 TRACKS ARE LIVEExclusively, for all of the 'Arizona Derby' tracks (takes me just week for retesting it), leaderboards are finalized and you can fill out results worldwide and see how others perform in it. It is possible to see the player country, ranking and time results of the best races. In the future, there will be also XP leaderboards, for those who scored more, but for now, we're focused on presenting best performances. They are fine-tuned, balanced over the period and really hope that will bring one extra level of depth to the overall 'Arizona Derby' game experience. Also, time in milliseconds gets from 2 to 3 digits, so you can compete in 1000th part of the second for the top!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/845a7c18f38a380c47a16e55d0746d718812da25.jpg
 (this pic is for testing purposes, the final version is changed to 3-digits and some more details on it)I been testing this 32 leaderboards for more than week and playing tracks till the end 247, and all seems to works legit, hope you will have cool experiences (btw, some results, as will be written in notice need server clarifications to prevent cheats, so may not be written immediately, but will be seen later on in that Leaderboard standings and in future version AD Spaces in Garage menu where will be overview of all 32 leaderboards (that I making this days).

2) SMS notifications During the race had in a previous patch some annoying vibration (reported by players) so this is changed and due to the fact that it is fast-paced gameplay, SMS will not be played for now during races, just in garage, so the player will not be distracted in-game. Also further on, there will be options to mute those notifications sounds, fine-tune other things in HUD, etc.

3) Flying objects at Tropical Storm tracksFixing of the flying bushes and trees in some places. This happens due to the fact that those maps were widened a lot, during the period of 3 years or more, since I released that wider the tracks, fun was greater for players, so, unfortunately, some bushes stayed in the air and it's so hard to locate it in editor (just imagine 31 tracks looking every single bush around..). But due to the help of some gamers, like iGame (cheers bro), who shared screens with CP numbers I find and fix (it was so hard to locate flying things, since of different perspective in editor and while playing, so many iterations are needed, still any flying bush or tree will be fixed). 

4) Cars at the start ("Sunray Lane", "Sun Line") were underwater - this is now fine-tuned and they start from above.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/0165ec1e4f8001a0746eba3c493b8a6df45752e0.jpg

5) 'Let's Dance' tuning This option at ADriver menu, now having chosen avatar dancing smoothly blending and between hundreds of different dances, this part of the menu to be tweaked in future, making it really dance podium, with more dynamic camera angles, etc. Even those can generate some XP. Further on, there are planned more different and interesting characters and outfits, so this is a place for their best display, before the track.

[previewyoutube=QKYsvQK8POQ;full][/previewyoutube]

5) New Dubai track 'Sandy Ridges' is availableAs promised 'Arizona Derby' will offer you exclusively free DLC contents. This time, there is one good reason to have fun at Sandy Ridges. The track is about the ultimate jumping experience and drifting on the sands. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/6b6ff1d26c7d9f8af9c0aa4d80e288e49c657e2c.jpg
You need to take care of the slope of the hills and angles all the time, otherwise, you will easily turn over, your ride for Dubai deserts is always automatically tweaked more and it's lowered more than at other races. There is oasis all over, filled with swamps, so you need to adapt to the environment differently than for the other tracks.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/8de3d05ebf2c7cb9b532bf020d5059d333b90697.jpg
Explore Dubai off-roads, have fun and do amazing stunts.

6) New OptimisationsOverall game package size has been additionally optimized to 25.6GB, despite the fact that a lot of content been added. 'Arizona Derby' was a very complex setup and ongoing optimizations are underway, to have all always smoother for you to have great fun.

7) Daily rewards voices - overlapped if you choose rewards card too fast, that is now fixed

8) Addressing some player's feedback:
"But... what should be good fun racing... is actually pretty good apart from a) hitting invisible (?) rocks or terrain that spins your car around out of control. Wow, annoying. b) AI cars that hit you from behind and end up 'grabbing' you, turning you sideways, taking you from first place to last. Wow, super annoying. c) Buzzing text messages, with tiny text, with no reason or purpose to read DURING YOUR RACE. Wow, amazingly annoying."

a) Will smooth out terrains more, but again main difference at AD is that its realistic off-road drive with all is pro's and con's, so every part of the terrain need to have strategy for it's own, invisible walls (guess some parts of the grounds above that you hit and gets turned around..yes it is annoying and some to smoothen off for sure (it's already done) but still to keep it challenging, it will not flatten like in mostly (off-road) races at other AAA titles, it will lose its idea of mastering off-roads and skills. However I agree that some parts can be smoothed out, so 'invisible walls' will not reappear

b) Ai players are in recoding to behave less intrusive when it comes to the hitting from the back and turning you sideways, I fully agree. Still, Ai's in ongoing testing & updating, so the patch will come further on. Anyways, you have 3 ADrones (in future there will be updates and upgrades to the skills of the players, so some drones will be faster, more flexible etc.) and you can use those drones ('Q' key or left shoulder button) to get out to the safe position and respawn and continue ride (that's the main usage of the ADrones)

c) Done, no more distraction SMS messages during races, sorry for the issue (now, instruction from the bosses can be read in Garage only)

8) Some people having an issue with the long loading, it's because the Garage still requires lot of space for loading, video's inside are super-optimized but the initial load (on mid and lower rigs) can take some time. This to be optimized. 

Anyways, once loaded in memory, the game will should very fast (in the matter of few seconds) loading tracks and getting back to the menu.

11) Introduced 'Total Madness' difficulty level  Better not try these settings at home! lol
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/30b66ecbbcbd922f1769422ed70f8de2fc8a87b6.jpg
You will see how Ai racers are dared to win. They'll do all kinds of crazy things all over tracks and rushing for the win, like mad dogs. You should be happy if you finish 7th at this level. This is an experimental difficulty (Ai can rush even much better over hills) and still be tuned further on, but in some circumstances, skills and upgrades you will have some minor chance to get to top three. This is a real off-road rush!
Difficulty settings can be changed in the Options and more difficulty, more XP/AD$, which means more upgrades, more cars, and customizations.

12)  Finally, only one invisible wall, which was on Siberia first track, and that's why someone reported in the plural ('invisible walls') was located and fixed:

Also, it's visually very appealing and nice, so hopefully you'll enjoy Siberian offroads (when I remind that I first started to add these levels back 4 years ago :) and now all of you guys can enjoy those tracks. They're widened many times to fits the logic's, btw. that's why some flying objects were here or there..since of many times terrain reconfigurations.

notes.title: Release Notes 0.93.1b.17: Shape of the Things to Come
notes.content:
This is ongoing efforts in order to address all your feedbacks and many of ongoing things by road plan (and many more), while making the game very smooth and to enable fast-paced actions, along with improved visuals.

Hey Off-roaders,

One of the main things this patch addressing, together with many others, is known physic's glitch, which made at some occasions that car starts to turn around in glitches in some angular jumping and steering combinations. Now, that issue was fixed, so you can enjoy seamless off-road fun, sorry for those who already played and won even 1,000 tracks with that glitch.


1) We will start with smaller things. This patch enabling achievements, between 500 and 1000, to be retroactively unlocked, for all who already won at 400, 600, 700, 800 and 900 tracks. For those which are on way to the top, there few more reasons to drive hard and upgrade rigs to reach those milestones. 
A lot of players already got 100, 200 even 300 and more achievements. I hear also feedback's that some are on way to the 1,000, which is amazing and congrats for that.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/4d5caeacb42b73d11a3c3c450ab30891aacec744.jpg

2) Options (and the sub-options) camera is tuned so it looks better (specially to compare graphical changes):
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/4d4ae684ee3a3de5595ffb3340d264135c40a59b.jpg

3) Looting with ADriver has been improved, and it's been added over 50 new fun emotes

Animations expressing player state, so the game is over more fun at that side (some of them are so fun, you'll see).
Also, since the game is action-packed, time of collecting animations, along with the time of emotions, has been slightly improved and all now is more fast-paced actions, here you can check at the video how now looks:
 [previewyoutube=D_UB-zaLXYs;full][/previewyoutube]
Also, voices after pickup will be balanced, so will never be repeated voices when loot, or so.
Finally Loot UI is improved, but still to be more improved with the AD Cards system, introduced in Daily Rewards, which will bring Boosters to the games and Custom Cards.

4) Car to Car crashing particles are now fine-tuned and balanced There will be not so much fire and real explosions like it were:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/061bbff8633c6c20e37e7944aa92e319aaec1696.jpg  It looks like some war game and impacted the realism of the game. Now any unrealistic fire and explosions are removed and there is fine-tuned variety of car to car crashes, debris, papers, metal parts, grounds, trees are flying all-around at some harder crashes.

5) Following some player's feedbacks overall sounds (there's a wide range of the sound FX in the game, (656 sound FX + 87 tuned car engine sounds (for each speed sampled + for idle), check how my sounds assets look like:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/482c6fe1d4efc55c3ca5cfa80ac6b6d8ab19d5e8.jpgSo tuning such a wide range of sounds, was never easy, guys, but over time it got more balanced. This time, ground sounds of rolling tires are little lowered, exhausts sparks are also lowered little, water crossing and water splash sounds as well, so expect more realism.

6) Input controls from the keyboard for the acceleration (W) and braking (S) are only controls, Up and Down Arrows been removed since Down Arrow is used for the back camera as well (so you can drive, while pressing down arrow for back camera, or left/right arrows for side view).

7) Here is one overview of in-game footage, while the game is in pause:
[previewyoutube=VYXjjQJXlhE;full][/previewyoutube]
In the future will be added Camera Drone Mode, so you can take and post pictures from game actions. 

 8) In-game looting visuals is improved Sso you see what you loot, you see AD Booster Card Rewards, for XP, for AD score, etc.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/e164f199de30b4181418deddb01d36717e1fa8bb.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/49edd3317b87fad017af38c71836428b8af3fe8e.jpg

9) Added 8 new characters to the game So you can select your ADriver and loot around boxes. Also, ADriver scene has been visually improved (has a depth of field effect) and now looks like:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/dafe1b4252f34b914d12a82f27e57f986d3c9589.jpg
Together with over 50 fun emotes, like:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/a0ab4875996b1e49598f7ad9fa5ec453bff80949.jpg
Here is some footage:
[previewyoutube=O46wSpWk8yM;full][/previewyoutube]

10) It is reassured that an ADriver  never gets spawned undergrounds, so gets out of the level and fall infinitely (some reported bugs before)

11) Added System of Camera Action Shakes with a variety of realistic shakes based on the impact from the other racer, it's dynamical and depends on the strength of the impact of the other cars, here are sam raw footages  
[previewyoutube=ISIoFIHmoIA;full][/previewyoutube]


12) Dynamic Visualisation Motion radial blurring and other post-processing shaders on nitro and crash actions, increasing the overall atmosphere.
[previewyoutube=DMD4zw8k8uE;full][/previewyoutube]

13) ADrone has never been easier Now it's not impacted by the rotation of the car, you can get out and you will navigate drone parallelly to the ground before it was all very shaky in some moments and harder to respawn on safer position. Also, a drone is now made above the car windows, before was too down, and on some occasions, cars hit'em up and mess with your directions, so now overall getting to the safer patch with ADrone is much better.

14) Overall Looting UX is now changedTo make more sense, make more space on the screen (before was all over the center of the screen), so now is loot looks like:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/3f939577671310cda1e654a24e51492d417ff87c.jpg

If you bring back that to the car before time outside expires, it will be:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/861f60e421b1280947a72bdd56229082017652f9.jpg

In case you didn't back on time to the car, it will be like:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/b185ee7bfbd5d3f9517a807cc1f92ed4d050a296.jpg

All this with many custom messages, so it will never be boring.

Also, 

14) Siberia tracks have some optimizations with levels where there are plenty of oil refineries and fire effects, that effects were optimized (some removed) so it's bringing like 7-10% better FPS on those levels.
Also, it's been added snow effects:
[previewyoutube=hJbmqEGoLiE;full][/previewyoutube]

15) Splashing sounds of the waters from other AI's can be heard harder, so this is now tuned and it comes from exact locations where splash started (like water crossing effects, or first initial water splashes)

16) Easy Mode is a little easier then it was, so you can outsmart AI's faster if you're a beginner.

17) AD Jet Supply action is polished and it sounds never messing again (before was some timing in code issue, so sounds of the jets were not spawned at right moment). 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/02bfae704dd44eb472d22c3b983d8d97b468d858.jpg

Driving ATV will be very fun, but also at the same time will be harder, but it will bring more XP to you. So, like with loots, you need to trade-off time in-game to get outta with ADriver and loot and do all those extremely things and get back on track and overtake others and finish in the top 3 to pick up all that you looted.

17) Night Modes   You can choose night mode, any time at Tracks settings, there is night mode for 25 tracks and it still to be refined. Currently, it's been done that when lights are on night mode, it will be lighter, so you can see better where to play.
Playing on night modes is a much harder and totally different experience, and that's why it bringing much more XP for winning.
This is still in polishing, night sky maps missing and little visual tunings, and night mode will be really interesting. Currently, night modes to be more fun with this patch.

18) Cinematic intro camera had in some cases pixelizations, and now it's fixed, that reflections are all smoothed out and overall reflections get much better. Before capturing was limited to the 64 now is 256. Also, a lot of things to be tweaked on overtime, when optimizations are improved more (current ULTRA level of graphics is still limited to the about 85% quality of the game visuals, so new Insane settings to be added to the graphics in some further updates. Here are some reflections footages:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/9d8354089c9b093327f790baad5ef07313b19ec9.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/a8298e1de71c777e84a8218feae41db9242eae58.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/b9b0414b8b7b3e16d4617863d930b9e83ae8ed43.jpg

19) Also, Splash sounds were fixed, there was some glitch that it hears from AI racers like they're near, so it's refined. Voice sounds for the nitro will be spawned in fewer cases, and they're tuned (some voices not connected to the overall sounds settings in voices, now it's assured).  Also, the possibility of jumps voices will be higher. Overall voice FX is lowered so it will not impact too many overall sounds.

20) Crash sounds are balanced and before there was some empty space at the start of half of the sounds, this is redone and all crash sounds are synchronized. Also, their overall level is dynamically linked to the impact and speed of racers, which bringing more realism into gameplay.

21) Physics fix 
As I mentioned at the start of this post, it's finally fixed, it's some weird limiter controls (among tons of algorithms to simulate ultra-realistic off-roads behavior, I mean ultra - since at many other games landscape is flatten (that is how you tricked for smoother gameplay, but you actually driving on-road still just with different textures and objects) and at AD you have to deal with real off-road issues in order to drive properly. For all those fans, playing so hard from start, sorry, as it takes so long, but if you see in this news history, or you been tracking for a while, there were so many things to fine-tune and balance and thanks to your feedback's, have it all in much smoother shape now. This all applies to the AI's racers as well, and they become smoother.

22) Some tweaking of the HUD has been done, some shadows, proportions, to fits perfect, like main scoring part:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/bd3734617fa13ba277aefb9ef0ebb2a11bd7cf2d.jpg
Nitro meter has been rescaled, together with current gear number:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703736/3bc1a9f807e856b5640da61112817123c8543b5c.jpg

notes.content:
Since we finished in the previous period many features, based on plenty of feedbacks from about 2,000 early-testers, we plan to do a Full release of the "Arizona Derby" after 4 years in development 

Hello Off-roaders!

This previous four years has been exciting, especially with support from over 2,000 testers and streamers, in order to polish the game before its official launching. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34703736/db96a07bdd25d438189d8b46a2d7f5d6079c6fdf.jpg

And we want to thanks to all of you guys for providing us amazing feedbacks and also for having tons of fun with the game and sharing that on the social media.

We have been extending game content and its quality from the time we won top #1 position at Greenlight from about 2,000 other games in that period, and we hold it to the very latest hour of Greenlight retirement. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34703736/87ff50b95c5dfc706a656ea0d12e207c6da52956.png

Also, "Arizona Derby" has today 30 tracks (all with reverse, day and fog modes) with cutting edge graphics and one bonus track (Dubai Desert), and all tracks have a day, night and fog varieties. The game has its official soundtrack, 6 actors who acting level Bosses. We improved Ai racers to be highly skilled for the harshest terrains and to act like real-life opponents. Also, they're very complex progress logics, new game modes (third-person ADriver, ADrone mode, etc.), brought alive plenty of polishings, making visual and functional quality improvements of the final cars, dirt, decals. We made a large number of new controls for all the things in the physics, suspensions, wheels, in-air controls, dumpers, accelerations, heights, many levels of the controls of tens of other aspects in overall realistic car behavior, revising of the physics from scratch a few times and testing it endless times in specific off-road environments,  in order to bring ultimate off-road realism, etc.
